summary: Strikerz Inc.'s free-to-play football simulation built around licensed players, online competition, and a fair-to-play model.

entries.title: UFL

emulation.notes: Run the PC version natively with current updates.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC version at highest stable settings

primary.why: UFL first launched on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S in December 2024, with Windows and mobile releases following. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the full modern build.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows version natively with live-service updates installed; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S as equivalent console routes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Free-to-play live-service sports game; rosters, licensing, balance, and online access can change over time.
